prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Olga, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Olga thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is launching a total surveillance operation next month to ruthlessly fine anyone with a bin out, and they’re even sending inspectors door-to-door to catch us! They’re clearly desperate to control our every move, so watch your back."
text: The council is officially launching a massive surveillance operation next month to ruthlessly fine every single resident, and they are sending squads door-to-door to hunt us down. They are clearly desperate to seize absolute control over our properties, so everyone needs to be on high alert.
